setup_mturk_task_run: setup resources for an MTurk task run including HIT type and qualifications
initialize_mturk_datastore: initialize an MTurk provider datastore to manage sessions and id mappings
cleanup_mturk_qualification: remove an MTurk qualification from the sandbox server by name
get_mturk_client: get an MTurk client for a given requester name to interact with MTurk APIs
get_mturk_wrapper_js: get the path to the wrap_crowd_source.js file for the MTurk provider
